question: Based on our customer pizza order information, summarize the total quantity of each ingredient used in the pizzas we delivered. Output the name and quantity for each ingredient.
sql:
SELECT 
    pco.order_id,
    pco.pizza_id,
    pr.toppings,
    regexp_split_to_array(pr.toppings, ',') as topping_array
FROM pizza_customer_orders pco
JOIN pizza_runner_orders pro ON pco.order_id = pro.order_id
JOIN pizza_recipes pr ON pco.pizza_id = pr.pizza_id
WHERE pro.cancellation IS NULL OR length(pro.cancellation) = 0
